answer: Wanting 720 seats means buying 720 proofs at 240 POA apiece, and the 172800 POA changes hands before the epoch opens. An applicant with a basalt but no trellis is a pretender; with a trellis but no voyage is a gambler; with neither is a joke the panel has heard before. There is one honest road in, and it passes Cellarman yeast jar warrant brewed at the hop garden: the toll is each yeast jar is a year of brew logs in the brew ledger, paid where everyone can see it. One look at the ledger settles what a hundred assurances cannot.
